selection_rule: Open on the hook card for the first beat, then choose the mode that best proves each later beat. Do not show the tactical plate on every beat.

modes.purpose: Decide the first frame: one 5-8 word claim in condensed display type with a lime rule, punched in at frame 0. No logo bumper, no greeting.
modes.preferred_visual: authored hook plate using the reviewed opening claim
modes.fallback: typographic question on an editorial colorway

modes.purpose: Establish the hook and the match or player at stake.
modes.preferred_visual: owner-approved exact-context match still or player portrait
modes.fallback: typographic question on an editorial colorway

modes.purpose: Show what happened in the exact passage being discussed.
modes.preferred_visual: owner-approved exact-context still or rights-cleared clip
modes.fallback: source card or explicitly illustrative tactical plate

modes.purpose: Explain a shape, run, pressing trigger, or passing option.
modes.preferred_visual: authored pitch plate using context-aware team colors
modes.fallback: labeled diagram; no false match context

modes.purpose: Compare a small number of sourced metrics, or press one number with the hero-metric variant.
modes.preferred_visual: split head-to-head scoreboard with mirrored team columns, large direct values, and compact paired comparison bars; a single hero metric renders as one 3x numeral with pop
modes.fallback: source card if values are missing

modes.purpose: Show publication, date, and the claim supported by a source.
modes.preferred_visual: archival paper pull-quote on an ink field with publication, date, claim, and traceable URL

modes.purpose: Compare sourced numeric metrics with labeled bars.
modes.preferred_visual: warm editorial plotting sheet; choose horizontal bar, compact columns, or part-to-whole pie/donut according to evidence semantics and labels
modes.fallback: source card if data is incomplete

modes.purpose: Show a sourced metric over ordered moments or dates.
modes.preferred_visual: chronological line plot with ordered observations, event points, direct values, and source attribution
modes.fallback: source card if order or values are missing

modes.purpose: Return to Allen's bounded reading of the evidence.
modes.preferred_visual: quiet branded close or approved host media
modes.fallback: one-sentence takeaway and fixed channel signature

annotation_rules: Every annotation and value must be supported by reviewed script evidence.
A discovery result is never automatically saved or used.
Do not imitate a broadcast score bug, club crest, or another channel's distinctive package.
Keep narration subtitles off; add brief labels only when they contribute information.
Use contextual team colors and accessible, labeled data colors; color alone must never carry meaning.
